snippet.title: IMP - Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
Updated trailer, featuring scenes from a variety of the worlds offered in IMP!  IMP will be available as early access with 3 base worlds October 2025. Each world is slightly randomized in each load, changing layout, weather, and key locations.

All of the scenes are real time captures, nothing pre-rendered.
